model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 三潭印月、天宇空明
evidence.excerpt_zh: 方壺勝境西北為三潭印月又西北度橋為天宇空明其後為澄景堂堂東為清曠樓西為華照樓（圓明園册）臣等謹按三潭印月天宇空明諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: North-west of 方壺勝境: 三潭印月; then over a bridge 天宇空明 with 澄景堂, 清曠樓 and 華照樓 behind.

evidence.title: 澄景堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.194, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-212
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四时景有嬗，八牖纳无央。讵在烟花赏，惟饶翰墨香。入微得理趣，澄尽识真常。逐处寻题咏，缘因取义长。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.

evidence.title: 澄景堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.195, under 天宇空明; source ref 9-281
evidence.excerpt_zh: 试言澄景趣，只觉趣偏长。聒耳无丝竹，怡情有缥缃。新诗五七体，古帖两三行。更散庭前步，天空水一方。
evidence.summary: Poem 澄景堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 天宇空明.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 澄景堂.
